questions.question: Which king of Assyria invaded Judah in Hezekiah's days?
How was the Assyrian army defeated?
options: The LORD sent an angel who destroyed the army
A long and grinding siege slowly wore the army down
A sudden and violent flood swept the whole camp away
A severe famine starved the entire invading force
questions.answer: The LORD sent an angel who destroyed the army
